headline: Co-op shares progression and smooths remote movement; native mods gain Android builds
summary: Co-op parties now share owned items, gold bolts and unlocked planets, while bolts drop once through the host and fly to the nearest player. Remote figures, held items and world objects move more smoothly over slow links, and standing figures no longer bob. Multiplayer v0.7.1 and v0.7.3 were published, with the latter among the new native-mod releases carrying Android builds against SDK 1.10.1.
highlights: Bolt pickup flights now remain visible to other players and run even away from their cameras. Ready toggles survive older host messages.
Difficulty v1.2.2, Button Swap v1.0.0 and Xbox Icons v1.0.0 were published against SDK 1.7.0; Multiplayer v0.7.1 used SDK 1.10.0.
Android releases include Difficulty v1.2.3, Item Randomizer v1.0.3, Lock Strafe v1.0.2, Live Splits v1.0.2 and Keyboard Mouse v1.2.4.
Ammo Max v1.0.2, Multiplayer v0.7.3, Xbox Icons v1.0.1 and DualSense v1.0.2 also ship Android builds. The native-mod patch bumps themselves leave code unchanged.
Contributors gain verbose remote-pose diagnostics and simulated message delay for testing slow links; multiplayer defaults to the public OpenRAC server.
